test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 11 Aug, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: In November 2022, Manika Batra created history by becoming the first Indian woman paddler to win a bronze medal in which event?
solution:
The correct answer is the __**ITTF-AATU Asian Cup.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Manika Batra **won a **bronze medal** in the **ITTF-AATU Asian Cup** in **November 2022.**
 
• This event is one of the most prestigious **table tennis tournaments** in Asia.
 
• The event featured top players from different countries in Asia, including **China, Japan, and South Korea.**
 
• Manika Batra's historic achievement has put India on the **map of table tennis** and has inspired many young players in the country.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Euro-Asia Cup** is a team table tennis event where players from **Europe and Asia **compete against each other.

 
 
• Compared to Europe's three victories, **Asia** has won the competition **nine times. **
 
 
 
• **Pan America Table Tennis Cup** is a regional tournament for players from **North, Central, and South America.**
 
 
• There are events for both men and women who are **single.**
 
• Each tournament can have a maximum of **16 invited players** and no more than **2 players **per association.
 
 
 
• **Table Tennis World Cup** is a major international tournament featuring the best players from different countries.
 
 
• Since **1980**, the World Cup of Table Tennis has been held **every year.**
